pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit high edge angularity with stellate or jagged pixel gradients. Shapes on the neck are elongated and larger in spatial area, while patches on the flank are smaller with more complex, irregular polygonal geometries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous network of cream-colored pathways with frequent tri-point and multi-point junction nodes. Corridor thickness is narrow and relatively uniform across the dorsal ridge but appears to widen slightly towards the mid-flank before being occluded by vegetation.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette is visible along the neck and hump, formed by short, dark, vertical hair projections against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A small avian organism (oxpecker) is perched on the posterior-dorsal region near the base of the rump.
